BiblicalUsage: Beth-Aven means "house of vanity." It was a city east of Bethel, site unknown. It turns up in Joshua 7:2, Joshua 18:12 and 1 Samuel 13:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beth-Aven is a real place God named, part of the land He gave His people.
